title: Bands here compared with New Orleans; brass band to orchestra
summary: Labat says local and New Orleans bands were similar, that only brass bands existed when he was a boy and orchestras appeared by his return.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: That's right. Did you have it when you were a kid or what? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. When I was a kid, you didn't have nothing but a brass band. I didn't say that much. I didn't say that much because I didn't play with them fellas out of the audience, you know. Yeah, and you just fit right in.
There couldn't be too much difference, you know.
Yeah, that's right. That's what Dixie played mostly, you know.
Well, when did the ragtime music start up over here? Did you have it when you were a kid or what?
No. When I was a kid, you didn't have nothing but a brass band. Mm-hmm. You didn't have the orchestra. When I come back from school, I found an orchestra, yeah.
And they were playing by head and playing writing stuff and everything?
Well, you see, they played and practiced great music, you know. Oh, yeah. They said, well, when all this jazz came out, they started trying to rag it too.
